correctness.rationale: Exact Walsh diagonalization yields eigenspace dimensions C(n,j) and PBH lower bound C(2r+1,r). The known harmonic Young decomposition of V_j into pair-difference sectors is explicitly sourced. On each sector the exact group-Walsh restriction equals alpha=(-2)^t(-1)^floor((j-t)/2) C(r-t,floor((j-t)/2)), never zero for n=2r+1 and t<=j<=r; orthogonality of the images gives injectivity. Frequency complements cover j>r. Even-central-layer frequency-complement dependence is exact. Standalone program passed 25,752 finite modular-rank/coefficient assertions; infinitely quantified result relies on proof, not finite enumeration.

This is best-knowledge originality, not proven uniqueness in all literature.

value.rationale: This is a natural network-control resource minimum with an exact eigenvalue multiplicity lower bound but non-obvious attainability by coordinate-selector inputs. The explicit central Hamming-layer construction is globally size-optimal for every odd dimension, and the even-dimensional full-layer parity obstruction supplies a sharp design boundary. It gives an exact benchmark and a vanishing actuator fraction of order 1/sqrt(n), not a routine substitution or finite table.
